neighbours.label: The opening of the qualifying claim after a concessive 'but' or 'albeit' that undercuts what came before (but he is a long way..., albeit a large one)
fire: She is often called the best chef in the city, but she is a long way from that reputation in truth.
The village has a cinema, albeit a tiny one with only twenty seats.
The team is said to be unbeatable at home, but it is unclear whether that is true this year.
He made a profit on the deal, albeit a small one after taxes.
Critics call the novel a masterpiece, but it is a long way from his best work.
The house came with a garden, albeit a narrow one behind the kitchen.
The robot can climb stairs, but it is unknown whether it can open doors.
They finally won a trophy, albeit a minor one in a youth league.
quiet: She is often called the best chef in the city, and she runs three busy restaurants.
The village has a cinema with only twenty seats near the square.
The team is said to be unbeatable at home and has won every game this year.
He made a profit on the deal and paid his taxes in March.
Critics call the novel a masterpiece and praise its final chapter.
The house came with a narrow garden behind the kitchen.
The robot can climb stairs and carry boxes to the top floor.
They finally won a trophy in a youth league last spring.

predictions: The first token after a concessive 'but'/'albeit' that limits a preceding claim reaches 0.3-0.5; the same sentences with additive 'and' or no qualifier stay under 0.1.
notes: Probe: 'but he is a long way from that title' 0.525 (peak ' a'), 'albeit a large one' 0.454, 'but it is unknown whether' 0.279; 'he was brave and strong, but he was rude' 0.065, 'only 4000 feet' 0.061, 'cautious estimate of 15 million' 0.052. Weak, low confidence.
